candidate_workaround: Retain the fatal error, withdraw the merge-count value, and rerun the merge count alone with the exact verified source revision and explicit exit-status check.
failure_signature: A Git verification summary mistyped the source revision in its merge-count subcommand, emitted an ambiguous-revision fatal error, and then coerced missing output to zero.
recurrence_guard: A summary is invalid if any child writes a Git fatal error; never coerce absent numeric output into evidence.
rollback: Give the failed summary no merge-count credit and do not commit evidence until the isolated ancestry command passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Reject ancestry summaries built from a mistyped source revision
